title: Microsoft Teams: Android device management moves to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
summary: The briefing passes: its portal paths, access requirements, minimum Admin Agent versions and retirement windows are supported. Minor corrections should acknowledge an outdated FAQ, describe end-of-life updates as available rather than guaranteed, and remove checklist instructions for controls not represented in the table.
